prompt:
Match the attached APPROVED website concept's artwork exactly: sculpted hand-cut matte cardstock, clean cut edges, many visible layered paper planes with soft directional cast shadows, ivory and kraft borders, forest green #1e4b34, cream #f6f0df, olive/sage #859b61, golden yellow #efb34f and natural tan. No pink, blush, turquoise, watercolor, painted fur, plush texture or glossy plastic. This is actual artwork for integration, not another screenshot of the website. No UI labels, text, buttons, baby photos or watermark.
Create a matching transparent TWELVE-ANIMAL SPRITE ATLAS: FOUR columns by THREE rows, each animal entirely isolated with generous clear margins, exactly one animal per cell. Image2 supplies species/order/pose/anatomy only; replace its gouache with the approved layered PAPER-CUT material from image1. All standing animals face right in clear side/threequarter view, full bodies, distinct visible near and far legs and complete tails. Heads proportional and eyes tiny dark dots, no white sclera. Do not copy its seated or hanging poses for lion/monkey: this library is for a walking parade. No grass, ground plane, backdrop, labels, text or frames. Alpha0 background. Row1: baby elephant with small gold party hat; tall giraffe with paper brown spots; cream zebra with forest-green paper stripes; lion cub with round layered ochre mane STANDING ON FOUR LEGS. Row2: monkey standing upright on TWO FEET with BOTH ARMS DOWN and curled tail; round four-footed hippo; small rhino with complete legs and short ivory horn; slender antelope with complete four legs. Row3: spotted baby cheetah with four paws; ostrich with exactly TWO complete legs; low crocodile with full tail and four splayed feet; little tortoise with patterned domed shell and four feet. Small soft cast shadows are part of paper layer depth on each character, not a floor shadow. Keep style consistent, natural silhouettes, not toy robots. Animals occupy about75percent of their cells, all feet near a consistent baseline within each row.
